visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images (hero, side, top) show no horizontal or vertical lines at 32-pixel or 16-pixel spacing. The diff signal is entirely unstructured.

visual_checks.evidence: No 32x32 or 16x16 constant-color fill blocks visible in any render. Rendered detail matches reference at all scales.

visual_checks.name: geometry_shift
visual_checks.evidence: Diff10 images show no distinct object silhouette outline that would indicate a coordinate offset. The faint low-amplitude dark regions in hero_diff10 and top_diff10 follow interior object regions, not displaced edges — consistent with bf16 rounding noise, not geometry shift.

visual_checks.name: diff10_structure
visual_checks.evidence: All three diff10 images are nearly entirely black — extremely low amplitude throughout. The faint interior-region noise is unstructured, spatially diffuse, and consistent with uniform sub-pixel quantization noise at bf16 precision. No grids, edges, gradients, or bands are present.

reasoning: All eight visual checks pass. The three diff10 images are essentially featureless black — no tile grid seams, no structured banding, no geometry shift silhouette, no NaN/Inf signatures. The faint dark regions visible in hero_diff10 and top_diff10 are sub-pixel-amplitude, follow interior object surfaces (not displaced edges), and are consistent with expected bf16 quantization noise. PSNR is 59.5–62.3 dB across all views, well above the 40 dB kernel-algebra floor. Per-view PSNR delta is 2.74 dB (threshold 20 dB). Per-view kernel-ms ratio is 1.16x (threshold 2x). Timing is median 99.34 ms vs prev_best 97.545 ms (+1.84%), within the 2% break-even band. p99/median ratio is 1.054x, well under the 3x suspicious-tail threshold. All numeric gates pass.
